description: Upload screenshots to a version localization for a device display type (e.g. APP_IPHONE_67). Handles Apple's reserve/upload/commit flow, refuses pixel sizes the display type does not accept, and reports Apple's processing state. replace:true (with confirm:true) clears the set first. Pro feature.

confirm.description: Required with replace:true, because it deletes live listing screenshots.

display_type.description: Device display type, e.g. APP_IPHONE_67, APP_IPHONE_65, APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129

files.description: Absolute paths to PNG/JPEG screenshot files, in order

platform.description: Which version, needed only when this app has versions in progress on more than one platform.

replace.description: Delete the screenshots already in this display type's set before uploading. Needs confirm:true.

name: upload_screenshots
title: Upload screenshots
